name: stepbench: does LSF's switching RATE help our label-free filter? (offline, exact saved states, psel run)
registered: 2026-10-25 ~12:20 EDT, before any stepbench replay ran
motivation: The latent safety filter's biggest single lever was checking at every model step (0.2 s) instead of every chunk (0.8 s): stage 1 halved dev topples (docs/LATENT_SAFETY_FILTER.md). Our filter checks once per chunk. Of psel's 16 residual topples (paired_cbfps3m_psel), 11 started inside a chunk the filter had just fixed and 5 inside an unfixed chunk. LSF's structure (least-restrictive switch at model-step rate, a cheap fallback) transfers without labels: our fork trigger is the switch, holding the target is the fallback.
cases: T: the topple-start chunk and the chunk before it, all 16 topple episodes of paired_cbfps3m_psel (32 chunk cases). C: 160 control chunks (chunk >= 1) drawn from v4b-success episodes of the same run, seed 20261025.
replay: from the saved chunk-start state, the run's executed commands with the run's execution noise (plausibility.episode_noises); replay fidelity reported (T cases whose topple onset reproduces).
step_check: at model steps j = 2, 4, 6 of the chunk: the deployed fork_3x trigger (fork scales 0.5-3, OIL model, 64 futures, h and o vs holding, TRIGGER both, O_MAX from cbf_calibration_OIL) on the REMAINING plan (current target, executed commands j..7, then the policy's logged look-ahead rows 9-15). Alarm = the trigger fires. The first alarm in a chunk is the switch point j*.
branches: at j* of alarmed T cases: continue (the run's commands j*..7) vs hold (target held, gripper at its current command, for commands j*..7); then the policy alone for 2 further chunks with the run's noise; K = 4 policy seeds per branch (common across branches). Outcome: neighbour topple (tilt >= 45) before the end.
primary: ALL of: (a) coverage: >= 8 of the 32 T cases alarm at a step before the replayed topple onset; (b) effect: over alarmed T cases, P(topple | continue) - P(topple | hold) one-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0 (cases resampled, seed 20261025, 10000); (c) cost: share of C chunks with any step alarm <= 15%. PASS -> implement the step-rate switch in our filter (psel at chunk boundaries + fork_step hold between) and pre-register a closed-loop test vs cbfps3m; FAIL -> the chunk rate stays.
secondary: alarms by step j and by case type (topple chunk / chunk before)
control alarms that coincide with grasp (gripper closing within the chunk)
notes: for chunks the run had fixed, the look-ahead rows are the policy's original plan (the chosen sample's look-ahead is not saved); exploratory caveat. Runs locally after cert_recheck and prune_check (one GPU process at a time).
